title: Same Day & Last Minute Movers in Los Angeles | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Same day movers in Los Angeles for moves that can’t wait: if a crew is free, we move you today. Hourly rates, a 3-hour minimum, crews 8AM – 6PM daily.
heroTitle: Same Day & Last Minute Movers in Los Angeles
heroSubtitle: Moving today? When one of our crews is free, it can take your move the same day. Call 909-443-0004 — we take requests for today Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM.

faq.question: Can you move me today?
faq.answer: Often, yes — if a crew is free when you call. Call 909-443-0004 with both addresses and a rough idea of the volume, and you will know on the same call whether today works or when the next opening is.

faq.question: Until what time can I call for a move today?
faq.answer: Any time during our working hours, Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM, as long as a crew is still free; there is no separate cutoff. The job itself also has to fit into the working day, so a call late in the afternoon may turn into a booking for the next morning.

faq.question: Do you move at night or on weekends?
faq.answer: Not at night: our crews work from 8AM to 6PM. Weekends are regular working days for us, billed at the Friday – Sunday rates from the table above.

faq.question: Is a same-day move more expensive?
faq.answer: No. A move booked for today is billed at the same hourly rates, minimums and fees as any other local move — there is no surcharge for short notice.

faq.question: Can you do a long-distance move on short notice?
faq.answer: Yes, when a crew and a truck are free. The price is a flat rate, worked out the same way as for any long-distance move, and the transit time depends on the route.

faq.question: My new place is not ready yet. What happens to my things?
faq.answer: An overnight hold costs $200 and lets us deliver the next day. For a longer gap between two addresses, your things can go into storage until you have the keys. Tell us on the first call, because it changes the plan for the day.

faq.question: Does my building need a certificate of insurance?
faq.answer: Many managed buildings ask for one. Get their exact requirements from management — the name to list, the coverage and the allowed hours — and send them to us; we prepare the COI for $50. On a move today, the building’s answer often sets the start time.

faq.question: How many movers do I need?
faq.answer: It depends on the volume, the stairs and the heaviest pieces. Anything over 300 lbs needs a crew of at least three, and a piano needs four; for everything else the office suggests a crew size on the call, and you confirm it before we dispatch.
